notes.title: Game Walkthrough Part 2
notes.content:
[b]Hi, friends![/b] 👋

Welcome back to the eerie world of SCP-087! Ready to dive deeper into the darkness?🔦 Here are some tips to help you navigate the second part of this spine-chilling adventure. 🕵️‍♂️



[b]1. Light Up the Darkness[/b]🔦

First things first, just like in Chapter 1, switch on the lights and grab the flashlight. Be careful not to fall into the holes in the stairs! 🕳️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/f01a85056814e01e973dc9532351568e610d2a8e.gif[/img]


[b]2. The Melting Painting[/b] 🎨

A creepy painting appears! As you approach, it melts into another image. Move the painting to find a key🗝️ underneath. Use this key to open the nearby door. 🚪
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/9b86fe9d1818bcb395cf82c5f9a1c3feda0a26de.gif[/img]


[b]3. The Sinister Room[/b]

Enter a spooky room filled with unsettling items. Make sure to pick up the head💀 on the table. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/a62f0993f2d8c2480c4ca1dfa79dde4e0eb23b26.gif[/img]


[b]4. The Altar Awaits[/b]

Place the head you found in the room next to the painting at the beginning. (Tip: The head from the room next to the altar won’t work!)🔑
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/4d029aa8669d83838c162201418b438445df0a76.gif[/img]


[b]5. Descend into Fate[/b]

Keep moving downwards and face your destiny. The deeper you go, the more intense it gets. 👣
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/1d95e74d1db7cb70c839af8c0a8d6cd7a5f6af7e.gif[/img]



[b]Enjoy the game! [/b]🎮 

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime. 📧 
Thank you!

notes.title: Game Walkthrough Part 1
notes.content:
[b]Hi, friends! [/b]

Ready to dive into the eerie world of SCP-087? Here’s the first part of the walkthrough to help navigate through the spine-chilling corridors and mysterious staircases. Let’s get started! 🕵️‍♂️



[b]1. Light Up the Way[/b]

On the wall, there’s a switch. Flip it to illuminate the next few floors of the staircase. 🌟 This will help see what’s ahead and perhaps avoid nasty surprises lurking in the dark.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/867d2ff9d76fa6231a189cd8d5d4e15222304332.gif[/img]


[b]2. Grab the Flashlight[/b]

There’s a flashlight on the table! 🕯️ Pick it up and turn it on. It will be your best friend as you venture deeper into the unknown.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/51d11a5ff39f1322813768f6776aa66ba042c5ea.gif[/img]


[b]3. Watch Your Step[/b]

Cracks have appeared on the staircase. Be careful not to fall into them! 🕳️ Also, if a phone booth appears and you receive a call, you can answer it. 📞 Who knows what vital information it might hold?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/d7af4350ee2876f977d1d71f288283bfcb315178.gif[/img]


[b]4. The Altar Puzzle[/b]

Pick up the head that is on the steps near the altar and place it on the altar, 🔮a purple light burning on the altar means you have succeeded! 

(Tip: Not every head will work! Make sure you grab the last one that appears, the one not far from the altar. 😉)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/e11be23d37d4a593288b330611ddb34b3966072b.gif[/img]


[b]5. Through the Iron Gate[/b]

Open the iron gate and pass through the mushroom field. 🍄 Press the elevator button and step inside. Now is the time to prepare for the next part of your journey!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/b174c4ad5347edad28033452fe76def7610d9542.gif[/img]


This is just the beginning! Stay tuned for Part 2 of the walkthrough, where even more mysteries await. 🕵️‍♀️[b]Hope this helps you out and enjoy the game! [/b]🎮 

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime. 📧 
Thank you!

notes.title: New Chapter Released!! Version 1.1🎉👻
notes.content:
Greetings, brave explorers of the SCP universe!ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː

We're thrilled to announce the release of SCP-087: [b]Chapter II[/b], a terrifying continuation of your journey into the depths of the SCP Foundation. This update brings a host of new content and improvements that will elevate your gaming experience to spine-chilling new heights. 

Here's what you can expect:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/5a91fccaec0b9e3379b86280eaafc742e0e9f074.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Content:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Chapter II Expansion:[/b] Dive deeper into the SCP-087's lore with an all-new chapter that will test your courage and wits like never before.
[*] [b]Achievement Overhaul:[/b] We've updated the achievement images and descriptions to make them more visually appealing and engaging. Unlock them to showcase your prowess in the face of terror.
[*] [b]Multiple Endings:[/b] The choices you make now matter more than ever. Shape the story and uncover a variety of endings that will leave you questioning your own sanity.
[/olist]

[h3]Enhancements:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Improved Display Effects:[/b] We've fine-tuned the visual effects to ensure that every jump scare, every shadowy corner, and every eerie sound is rendered with the utmost clarity and impact.
[*] [b]Optimized Performance:[/b] Under the hood, we've made performance tweaks to ensure that your descent into madness is as smooth as possible.
[/olist]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Bug Squashing:[/b] We've addressed several reported issues, ensuring that your experience is as bug-free as it can be in the unsettling world of SCP-087.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/3196f5e90b705eff1663b1c3369109d1f962527d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Community Shoutout:[/h3]
A special thank you to our community for their invaluable feedback and support. Your bravery in exploring the unknown with us is the lifeblood of this game.

[b]SCP-087: Chapter II[/b] is now available on Steam. Will you dare to step into the darkness once more? The SCP Foundation awaits...

[b]Note: [/b]This update requires the base game to play. If you haven't embarked on this terrifying journey yet, what are you waiting for?

Happy haunting, and remember—don't blink.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/ad105dd14721ad66ea56d05db8ad5938b7d427c1.jpg[/img]

SCP-087 Development Team

notes.title: New Games Upcoming! Come and Enjoy!
notes.content:
Hi, SCP-087 fans! ːsteamhappyː

We have three new horror games coming soon! ːsteammockingː
These games are also created by independent developers using the Yahaha Horror Game Kit!


[h3]《Myst of Guatemala》[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3094220/

[b]Myst of Guatemala[/b] is inspired by a real historical event: the Guatemala Syphilis Experiment. 
In the game, you will play as a brave investigative journalist following a distress signal from a long-missing comrade. You will uncover the secrets of Guatemala step by step. 
The game includes 4 chapters filled with plenty of jump scares and puzzle mechanics! It’s sure to keep you on the edge of your seat!




[h3]《Home Snatch》[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3104550/

[b]Home Snatch[/b] draws inspiration from horror movies like HOSTEL, aiming to create a tense and immersive experience that captures the essence of these films. 
In Home Snatch, you become one of the victims of mysterious kidnapping events, exploring the truth behind the disappearances and struggling to survive as night falls. 
The game features 4 chapters, with rich story elements and collectible items that will make you feel truly immersed!




[h3]《Wedding Day》[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3078650/

[b]Wedding Day[/b] is inspired by the ancient Chinese custom of "ghost marriage" and aims to condemn this practice. 
In the game, you will explore a mysterious and eerie Eastern village shrouded in darkness, uncovering hidden clues and solving puzzles to find a way to free the restless spirit of a young woman. 
The game includes 5 chapters, with captivating storylines and abundant level items that will take you deep into ancient Eastern customs!






[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088058/ce565e9e3fb13b66f7a4aca54b733ddfd063daf4.png[/img]

Be sure to visit the store page for more details and add the games to your [i][u][b]wishlist[/b][/u][/i]!
We will offer the most sincere discounts! Please stay tuned!
We welcome any feedback, so feel free to leave your comments! We embrace all feedback with an open mind. ːsteamthumbsupː
And of course, if you’re interested, join our [url=https://discord.gg/zxzw5t7m6w]Discord[/url] ! 
Connect with us directly and stay in touch!
